github.title: Load every Python script on Python 3.9
github.author: jerridan

identity.head: d2d3cebefec7dddc9f7227dcedfd683a9b2d5510
identity.description:
Load every Python script on Python 3.9

## Summary

On macOS, the `python3` that ships with the system is Python 3.9. Four crew scripts stopped at import on it, because their type hints use a form that Python 3.9 cannot read at run time. `crew-stats.py`, the script a person runs, was one of them. Now every script of the plugin loads and runs on Python 3.9, and the README states Python 3.9 as the lowest version a run needs.

Closes #162

**Ticket:** [Issue 162](https://github.com/jerridan/crew/issues/162)
**Type:** Bug fix

---

## Agent context

### Authority

- `docs/design.md` §15 entry 51 (found the fault in `spend.py` and `crew-stats.py`) and the new §15 entry `NNN` (placeholder; the principal assigns the number).
- `.claude/rules/readme.md`: a new launch requirement goes in "What a run needs".

### What changed, by file

- `skills/project-lead/scripts/spend.py`, `crew-stats.py`, `crew-record.py`, `hooks/pre-compact.py`: each starts with `from __future__ import annotations`, so Python 3.9 stores each `X | None` annotation as text and does not evaluate it.
- `README.md`: a "Python 3.9 or newer" row in "What a run needs".
- `docs/design.md`: new §15 entry `NNN` that records the fault, the fix and the check.
- `.claude-plugin/plugin.json`, `.claude-plugin/marketplace.json`: version set to the placeholder `0.1.VERSION-TBD`. The principal assigns the real number before the merge.

### Constraints that applied

- A change under `hooks/` and `skills/` bumps the version in both manifests. Both carry the same placeholder until the principal sets the number.
- No file of the concurrent orchestrator work (`launcher.py`, `crew-orch.py`, their tests, the orchestrator references) changed. `launcher.md` also says that `launcher.py` needs Python 3.9 or newer. It agrees with the README, so it stays as it is.

### How this was verified

On `/usr/bin/python3` 3.9.6:
- Every `.py` file of the plugin imports with no error. Before the change, `spend.py`, `crew-stats.py`, `crew-record.py` and `pre-compact.py` failed with `TypeError: unsupported operand type(s) for |: 'type' and 'NoneType'`. The one exception is `iterm2-tabs.py`: its `iterm2` package comes from `uv run --with iterm2` at run time. It parses on 3.9.
- `crew-stats.py` reads the whole record root and exits 0. `crew-stats.py --help` exits 0.
- `crew-record.py init` and `run state blocked` write a new record in a scratch directory.
- `pre-compact.py` exits 0 on the payload `{}`.
- A search for other features newer than 3.9 (`match`, `zip(strict=)`, `slots=True`, `tomllib` and similar) found none.

### Known gaps

- The version and the §15 number are placeholders.

The diff also sets the plugin and marketplace versions to "0.1.VERSION-TBD", which looks like a leftover release placeholder.

finding.explanation: The check was a one-off manual run on /usr/bin/python3 3.9.6, and no committed test fails when a script stops importing on 3.9.
